learning_objective: 🎯 Let's learn how fast and slow beats make us move differently, and discover how to draw that exciting musical energy!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Tempo is a musical word for speed! Some songs have a slow, sleepy tempo like a tortoise, while others have a fast, jumping tempo like a cheetah.
When we draw a fast dance, we use sharp, zigzag lines and bright, splashing colors to show speed and high energy on our paper.
For a slow, peaceful dance, we use smooth, gentle wavy lines and calm colors like light blue or soft pink to show relaxation.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Tempo Scribble Game!
fun_activity.instructions: Play a very fast song and scribble wild, sharp lines on a paper. Then, switch to a slow song and draw slow, loopy circles. See how different the art looks!

quick_recap: ⭐ Tempo tells dancers and musicians how fast or slow to move.
⭐ We can use sharp lines and bright colors to draw fast, energetic dancing.
⭐ Smooth, wavy lines help us draw a slow, peaceful, and gentle dance.
